decision.rationale: Advance the exact live provider binding to representative evaluation because it reproduced the fixture integration gates without weakening deterministic authority. Do not select V2.1 for release from this small checkpoint.
limitations: Only two reactive turns and one proactive opportunity used one public synthetic cache-coherence release.
The aggregate runner persisted call counts and reported cost but did not surface input/output token totals or per-call latency; those operational measures remain required in #157.
This result does not evaluate professor fidelity, real students, learning outcomes, long-horizon autonomy, or the sealed factual benchmark.
The selected implementation is selected only for deeper evaluation; the V2.1 release candidate remains unselected and T1-v1/T0 remain control and rollback.
